entities.name: The Maelstrom
entities.description: Chaotic storm of mana created in the Conflux where the five Shards of Alara met.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: Event that merged Alara's shards and created the Maelstrom.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: Plane whose five shards met at the Maelstrom.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon planeswalker who orchestrated the war and stepped into the storm to regain his powers.

entities.name: Child of Alara
entities.description: Monstrous entity that sprang from the Maelstrom.

entities.name: Maelstrom Wanderer
entities.description: Monstrous entity that sprang from the Maelstrom.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Planeswalker who stopped Bolas from destroying all of Alara.

entities.name: Sundering
entities.description: Event predating many of the obelisks.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which the Maelstrom rose in defense of the plane.

events.summary: Bolas orchestrates the war between the five worlds and channels mana through obelisks into the Maelstrom.
events.quote: a war that the elder dragon Nicol Bolas orchestrated

events.summary: Bolas steps into the storm and regains his godlike powers but is stopped by Ajani Goldmane from destroying Alara.
events.quote: was ultimately stopped from destroying all of Alara by Ajani Goldmane

events.summary: The Maelstrom rises against the Phyrexians in defense of the plane.
events.quote: the Maelstrom itself rose against the Phyrexians in defense of the plane

relations.quote: was ultimately stopped from destroying all of Alara by Ajani Goldmane
